leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a basic HTML structure for the typeahead input and results container
Initialize and manage the state for user input and filtered suggestions
Implement an event handler to capture and process user keystrokes
Apply a filtering algorithm to match input against a dataset of suggestions
Render dynamic search results that update based on the current input
Bind keyboard navigation events to allow selection of suggestions
Control the visibility of the results dropdown based on user interaction
